Summary and goals

The orders service imports order files from the warehouse and lets sales reps look up and admins delete orders through an HTTP API.

Goals:

  • Import a 10,000-row file in under 60 seconds.
  • Answer an order lookup within 300 ms at p95.
  • Skip every duplicate row and log it, with zero duplicate orders stored.

Personas: a sales rep (looks up own orders) and an admin (also deletes orders).

Out of scope: order creation through the API, payments, shipping.

Glossary

Term Meaning Banned synonyms
order A customer's request for goods, stored once per order_key purchase
customer The person or company an order belongs to client

User journeys

UJ-01 Rep looks up an order live since 1.0.0

1. Rep asks for an order by id → 2. API returns it, or ORDER_NOT_FOUND.

Requirements: api

FR-002 Get an order live since 1.0.0

  • AC-002.1 When a rep requests an existing order through op:getOrder, the API shall return the order with its status.
  • AC-002.2 If the order id does not exist, the API shall respond 404 with error ORDER_NOT_FOUND.

FR-003 Delete an order live since 1.0.0

  • AC-003.1 When an admin deletes an existing order through op:deleteOrder, the API shall remove the order and respond 204.
  • AC-003.2 If a rep calls op:deleteOrder, the API shall respond 403 with error FORBIDDEN and keep the order.

Requirements: import

FR-001 Import an orders file live since 1.0.0

  • AC-001.1 When an imported row has a new order_key, the importer shall insert the row into orders.
  • AC-001.2 When an imported row's order_key already exists, the importer shall skip the row and log IMPORT_DUPLICATE once for it.
  • AC-001.3 If the import file is empty, the importer shall finish with status empty, log IMPORT_EMPTY and insert no rows.

  • Language: Python 3.12

  • Not used: message brokers, ORMs, front-end frameworks

Architecture

flowchart LR
  Importer --> DB[(PostgreSQL)]
  Importer --> Geocoder
  API --> DB

The importer reads a file, validates postal codes with the geocoder, and writes to the database. The API reads and deletes orders. The geocoder is the only external service.

  • deleteOrder
  • getOrder

IMPORT_EMPTY0The import file holds no rows.
ORDER_NOT_FOUND404No order has the requested id.
FORBIDDEN403The caller's role may not perform the operation.
GEOCODER_TIMEOUT504The geocoder did not answer in time or failed.

Runbook

  1. Deploy to staging (agent, staging)
    • Run: ./deploy.sh staging
    • Check: curl -fsS https://orders-staging.example.com/health prints ok
    • Rollback: ./deploy.sh staging --previous
  2. System tests on staging (agent, staging)
    • Run: tests system, e2e
  3. Approve production (human, production)
    • Do: read the staging results and reply "deploy production"
    • Check: the reply says "deploy production"
  4. Deploy to production (agent, production)
    • Run: ./deploy.sh production
    • Check: curl -fsS https://orders.example.com/health prints ok
    • Rollback: ./deploy.sh production --previous
  5. Smoke on production (agent, production)
    • Run: tests smoke
